summary: Linkers Industries Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 29, 2026, reporting the resignation of independent director Ms. Wan Man CHAN for personal reasons, with no dispute or disagreement, and the immediate appointment of Ms. Mei Kuen Mak as her replacement. Ms. Mak brings over 20 years of audit, financial reporting, and governance experience, currently serving as CFO of Quam Plus International Financial Limited. The committees were redesignated accordingly. This is a routine board change, not a forced departure or special situation. No deal terms, strategic action, or event-driven catalyst is present. No investor action warranted.
